Fixed on `refactor/modules`; tests still pass (517). I changed four things, and one needs your call:

1. **Unknown discount code:** `applyDiscountCode` in `src/discount.js` returned 0 for an unknown code. On `main` it throws `unknown code: X`, so I restored the throw.
2. **Minimum quantity:** `src/lineItems.js` accepted `qty: 0` because the new `assertInt` call used a minimum of 0. `main` requires `qty >= 1`, so I set the minimum back to 1.
3. **FX rates:** the last commit (`4376a4e`) changed all the display rates in `src/currency.js` away from the `main` values. That isn't a refactor, so I restored the `main` rates. If the refresh was intentional, put it in its own commit or PR rather than on this branch.
4. **`require('./money')`:** the split removed `src/money.js`, which would break any caller using the old path. I added `src/money/index.js` that re-exports `round` and `format`, so the old path works again.

A diff against `main` (ignoring quote and semicolon style) shows nothing else different in `src/`. The only other differences are renamed locals and the arrow-function style. I didn't commit anything.

I didn't add tests for the restored behaviours; the existing suite didn't catch them, so tests for an unknown code and for `qty: 0` would be worth adding.
